training_metrics.storage_scope: logical finalized dataset and initial/final checkpoint file sizes; excludes logs, temporary-file peaks and post-timing audit/evaluation artifacts

cpu_utilization.scope: continuing owned PID-tree CPU time; short-lived/new/missing PID intervals may be omitted; capacity denominator is owner's assigned affinity

GPU-afe5dd63-2838-06db-b0fa-5d98d4b1eec5.scope: whole-board NVML recent-window utilization including foreign work; sample mean, not exclusive owned-kernel busy time

GPU-a5477f57-58a6-4f89-6e7a-338d8fcfc6f1.scope: whole-board NVML recent-window utilization including foreign work; sample mean, not exclusive owned-kernel busy time

resources.memory_scope: sampled owned-process PSS and NVML context memory across devices (max per PID/device before sum); primary device total separately diagnostic; not guaranteed peaks

post_audit.scope: post-timing numeric/checkpoint, source-window SDK and all-frame video integrity audit; no duration contributes to pipeline time

video_quality.scope: fixed raw RGB references versus standard CPU video decoding; excluded from timed consumption

full_video_integrity.scope: post-timing sequential software decode/count integrity; no lossless RGB, policy-quality or all-SDK-seek claim
full_video_integrity.frame_hash_scope: SHA256 of decoded rawvideo YUV420p planes; not RGB or BC-normalized tensors

files.frame_hash_scope: SHA256 of FFmpeg decoded rawvideo YUV420p planes; not RGB or BC-normalized tensors
